title: 🔆🔅Tehran, October 19, 2026 - Hossein Mohebbi, IRGC spokesman, made statements.
text:
🔆🔅Tehran, October 19, 2026 - Hossein Mohebbi, IRGC spokesman, made statements."

"==========="

"SOT1, Hossein Mohebbi, IRGC Spokesman (Farsi)-(00:00 - 00:25): "Today, Iran has emerged as a power that has unsettled the world’s leading superpower—a country that once held the primary position in both numerical strength and military equipment. Iran has now shattered that standing.""

"SOT2, Hossein Mohebbi, IRGC Spokesman (Farsi)-(00:26 - 00:52): "If he is wise, he understands that even if he were to use this bomb and inflict even a fraction of the damage on our country, it would bring him no strategic gain. If the United States is seeking achievements, it should accept our conditions rather than resort to that bomb, because doing so offers it no achievement—and, for us, that is immaterial.""

"SOT3, Hossein Mohebbi, IRGC Spokesman (Farsi)-(00:53 - 01:42): "Trump is a criminal individual; there is no doubt about his criminality. It is not unlikely that he has committed numerous crimes during this so-called short period and may commit another. The very nature of the American regime is criminal; it is fundamentally based on crime. If we were to list America’s crimes around the world, the list would be very long. It is not unlikely that the United States might commit another crime, but in our view it is not doing so at present because it is not in a position to do so. The United States has exhausted all its capabilities and failed.
